name: How much cabinet storage should an ADU kitchen have?

mainEntity.name: What is the right amount of storage in a small ADU kitchen without making it feel cramped?
mainEntity.text: What is the right amount of storage in a small ADU kitchen without making it feel cramped?

acceptedAnswer.text: In an ADU kitchen, storage has to be planned carefully because every inch of wall space matters. The goal is to support daily use without making the room feel overbuilt or closed in. Deep drawers, pull-outs, corner solutions, and tall pantry cabinets often provide more usable storage than simply adding more upper cabinets. In compact spaces, it is often better to maximize function through organization than to cover every wall with cabinetry. That keeps the kitchen lighter visually and leaves room for circulation and natural light. Homeowners should think through what really needs to live in the ADU kitchen: cookware, dishes, dry goods, cleaning items, recycling, and maybe a few small appliances. If the unit is meant for rental use, storage should be durable and easy to understand, not overly customized. The best ADU kitchens feel easy to live with because everything has a logical place, not because they have the most cabinets on the plan.
acceptedAnswer.description: An ADU kitchen should have enough storage for daily cooking, dishes, pantry items, and cleaning supplies without blocking circulation. Deep drawers, vertical storage, and full-height cabinets often work better than oversized cabinet runs in a small plan. The right amount is usually more about smart organization than sheer cabinet count.
